title: StealthOS · Private Browser, Tor, Vault, AI & Encrypted Calls for iPhone
excerpt: StealthOS is a private browser, Tor, password manager, encrypted vault, secure notes, on-device AI, and end-to-end voice & video calls · in one iPhone app. No accounts. No tracking.
content_html:
Available now on the App Store

Privacy without
compromise.

StealthOS is a private browser, Tor, password manager, encrypted vault, secure notes, on-device AI, and end-to-end voice & video calls · in one iPhone app. No accounts. No tracking.

Private BrowserBuilt-in TorEncrypted VaultVoice & Video CallsApple Intelligence AI

Download for iPhoneSee what's inside

No account requiredZero analyticsOn-device by designOpen security source

Everything in one app

Twelve privacy tools.
One private app.

StealthOS replaces the bag of single-purpose privacy apps you'd normally cobble together. Each module is built to work standalone · and to make the next one stronger.

Browser · Tor · Onion

Browse the open web.
Or the deep one.

A privacy-first browser with built-in Tor, .onion support, and a kill switch · no second app to install. Up to 50 tabs with session restore, encrypted history, encrypted downloads, and DNS-over-HTTPS.

  • Built-in Tor with .onion routing and on-demand new circuits
  • Kill Switch instantly halts traffic if Tor disconnects
  • WebRTC leak blocking so your real IP never escapes
  • DNS-over-HTTPS, proxy support, and password autofill

Browser engine powered by Owl Browser

Anti-fingerprint

A new device,
every visit.

Trackers stitch your identity together using Canvas, WebGL, Audio, Fonts, Timezone, Screen, and Navigator signals. StealthOS spoofs them with realistic, consistent profiles · so the picture they get isn't yours.

  • Spoof Canvas, WebGL, Audio, Fonts, Timezone, Screen, Navigator
  • Multiple device profiles you can switch on demand
  • Premium unlocks up to 10 fingerprint profiles
  • WebRTC IP leak blocking always on

Encrypted Vault

Your sensitive stuff,
sealed by your phone.

Files, photos, downloads, notes, and private documents in one workspace · encrypted with AES-256-GCM and unlocked through Secure Enclave-protected keys. The vault belongs to your device alone.

  • AES-256-GCM at rest with keys in the Secure Enclave
  • File manager for documents, photos, downloads, notes, and private files
  • Generate and securely store PGP key pairs
  • Face ID / Touch ID unlock · no cloud sync, no key escrow

Passwords · TOTP

One vault for every login,
autofilled in-app.

A built-in password manager with autofill in the StealthOS browser, a strong-password generator, real-time strength scoring, and TOTP for 2FA. Scan the QR code or paste the secret · it's yours from then on.

  • Autofill across StealthOS Browser and Tor
  • Password generator with length, symbol, and pattern controls
  • TOTP (2FA) with QR scanning, organized by category
  • Field-level encryption and Face ID gating on every reveal

Voice & Video Calls

Call without a number.
End-to-end encrypted.

Voice and video calls run over Connection Pool · local peer-to-peer when you're nearby, or via your StealthRelay when you're not. Hardware-accelerated H.264, ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption, no phone number required.

  • End-to-end encrypted voice and video calls
  • Local P2P over WiFi/Bluetooth, or via your own relay
  • 1-on-1 and group calls inside any pool
  • No phone number, no SIM, no contact-list upload

Connection Pool

One pool.
Everything you do together.

Pools are the social layer of StealthOS · chat, voice, video, multiplayer games, and relay tunneling, all over a single end-to-end encrypted connection. Pools stay alive when the host goes offline, so friends keep talking and playing without waiting for you to come back.

  • End-to-end encrypted messaging in every pool
  • Pools stay alive while the host is offline · reconnect with the same key
  • Open-source StealthRelay support for self-hosted private relay
  • Local peer-to-peer or remote relay · same UI, same encryption

Relay Exit

Exit at your relay's IP,
not your home network.

Route the app's browser and built-in network requests through your self-hosted StealthRelay. Destinations see the relay's IP, not yours · and the relay only sees ciphertext, because TLS to the destination stays end-to-end.

  • Browser & app traffic exits at your relay; TLS stays end-to-end
  • Affects only StealthOS app traffic · other apps are untouched
  • Per-pool host approval decides who else can use it as an exit
  • Off by default · automatic kill switch if the relay refuses traffic

System Snapshot

Take your whole system
with you.

Save everything StealthOS holds · files, passwords, notes, browser history, settings · into one encrypted file, then restore it whenever you want. Even after a factory reset, or on a brand new install. It's encrypted with a passkey only you know, so nothing from the old device is needed to open it.

  • One file holds your vault, passwords, notes, browser data and settings
  • Encrypted with your passkey alone · AES-256-GCM, tamper-evident
  • Keep it in Files, iCloud Drive, or move it to a computer · we keep no copy
  • Restoring verifies the whole file before it replaces anything

There is no recovery without the passkey · not by you, not by us, not by anyone.

AI Safety

Threats caught
before you load them.

On-device AI flags phishing pages, scam patterns, and suspicious domains the moment a link is tapped · not after your credentials are gone. Domain intelligence, content blocking, and a duress password give you a stack of safety nets, all running locally.

  • AI phishing detection for fake login pages and scam sites
  • Domain intelligence for newly-registered, shared-IP, and impersonating domains
  • Content blocking for ads, trackers, and fingerprinting scripts
  • Duress password: emergency wipe with a single login

On-device AI

An assistant that
stays on your device.

Powered by Apple Intelligence on iOS 26+. Choose a profile · writing, coding, tutoring, planning, research, analysis · talk to it with voice mode, save answers to Notes, or export code blocks straight to a file. Nothing leaves your phone.

  • Profiles for writing, coding, tutoring, planning, research, and analysis
  • Voice mode with interruption support, plus web research and weather
  • Save answers to Notes or export code blocks as files
  • Requires iOS 26+ with Apple Intelligence

Notes · Voice · Reminders

Capture the day,
don't broadcast it.

Text and voice notes with on-device transcription, automatic summaries, and inline checklists. Reminders fire as private local notifications · never round-tripped through a cloud service.

  • Voice notes with multi-speaker transcription and summaries
  • Reminders, pinning, and 8 colour-coded categories
  • Inline checklists for daily todos and meeting follow-ups
  • Everything stored inside the encrypted vault

Virtual Desktop

A workspace
behind one password.

A windowed, themable workspace with movable windows, folders, and a password lock · 15+ built-in apps for private productivity and communication, all inside the same encrypted shell.

  • Movable windows, folders, themes, and a master password lock
  • 15+ built-in apps for productivity and communication
  • Notes, Calculator, Files, Profiles, Help, AI, and more
  • Pool Chat, Voice/Video, Games · all over Connection Pool

Multiplayer Games

Play with friends
over your own pool.

Nine multiplayer titles · Chess, Ludo, Connect Four, Chain Reaction, Memory Rush, Word Guess and more · running over the same end-to-end encrypted Connection Pool. No matchmaker, no game server, no third-party seeing your moves.

  • Nine titles across strategy, memory, and word play
  • End-to-end encrypted multiplayer over Connection Pool
  • Local peer-to-peer when nearby, or via your relay anywhere
  • Pools stay alive while the host is offline

Premium · Workstation

A pocket workstation
when you need one.

Premium unlocks the developer side of StealthOS: SSH terminal with Linux shell, a syntax-aware code editor, NetMap network inspector, and up to 10 device fingerprint profiles. Same encrypted vault, same on-device guarantees.

  • Up to 10 device fingerprint profiles
  • SSH terminal and Linux shell
  • Code editor with syntax highlighting
  • NetMap network inspector

Premium · supports continued development

Privacy · Free forever

Every privacy feature.
Free, forever.

Tor, encryption, anti-fingerprinting, calling, and the AI assistant are free forever · no account required, zero analytics, zero tracking. Premium funds the project; it doesn't gate the privacy.

  • No account required · open the app, you are in
  • Zero analytics, zero tracking, no ads
  • On-device processing where supported; works offline for core features
  • Open security source · verify the claims yourself

Open security source

Don't trust us.
Read the code.

Privacy claims are cheap · open source is proof. Every cryptographic decision and every network call in StealthOS lives in repos you can audit, fork, and run yourself.

Get the app

Privacy without compromise.
In your pocket.

Free to download. No account. No tracking. Premium unlocks 10 fingerprint profiles, SSH terminal, Linux shell, code editor, and NetMap.

content_html_zh:
Available now on the App Store

Privacy withoutcompromise.

StealthOS is a private browser, Tor, password manager, encrypted vault, secure notes, on-device AI, and end-to-end voice & video calls · in one iPhone app. 没有账户。 没有跟踪。

Private BrowserBuilt-in TorEncrypted VaultVoice & Video CallsApple Intelligence AI

Download for iPhoneSee what's inside

No account requiredZero analyticsOn-device by designOpen security source

Everything in one app

Twelve privacy tools.One private app.

StealthOS replaces the bag of single-purpose privacy apps you'd normally cobble together. Each module is built to work standalone · and to make the next one stronger.

Browser · Tor · Onion

Browse the open web.Or the deep one.

A privacy-first browser with built-in Tor, .onion support, and a kill switch · no second app to install. Up to 50 tabs with session restore, encrypted history, encrypted downloads, and DNS-over-HTTPS.

  • Built-in Tor with .onion routing and on-demand new circuits
  • Kill Switch instantly halts traffic if Tor disconnects
  • WebRTC leak blocking so your real IP never escapes
  • DNS-over-HTTPS, proxy support, and password autofill

Browser engine powered by Owl Browser

Anti-fingerprint

A new device,every visit.

Trackers stitch your identity together using Canvas, WebGL, Audio, Fonts, Timezone, Screen, and Navigator signals. StealthOS spoofs them with realistic, consistent profiles · so the picture they get isn't yours.

  • Spoof Canvas, WebGL, Audio, Fonts, Timezone, Screen, Navigator
  • Multiple device profiles you can switch on demand
  • Premium unlocks up to 10 fingerprint profiles
  • WebRTC IP leak blocking always on

Encrypted Vault

Your sensitive stuff,sealed by your phone.

Files, photos, downloads, notes, and private documents in one workspace · encrypted with AES-256-GCM and unlocked through Secure Enclave-protected keys. The vault belongs to your device alone.

  • AES-256-GCM at rest with keys in the Secure Enclave
  • File manager for documents, photos, downloads, notes, and private files
  • Generate and securely store PGP key pairs
  • Face ID / Touch ID unlock · no cloud sync, no key escrow

Passwords · TOTP

One vault for every login,autofilled in-app.

A built-in password manager with autofill in the StealthOS browser, a strong-password generator, real-time strength scoring, and TOTP for 2FA. Scan the QR code or paste the secret · it's yours from then on.

  • Autofill across StealthOS Browser and Tor
  • Password generator with length, symbol, and pattern controls
  • TOTP (2FA) with QR scanning, organized by category
  • Field-level encryption and Face ID gating on every reveal

Voice & Video Calls

Call without a number.End-to-end encrypted.

Voice and video calls run over Connection Pool · local peer-to-peer when you're nearby, or via your StealthRelay when you're not. Hardware-accelerated H.264, ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption, no phone number required.

  • End-to-end encrypted voice and video calls
  • Local P2P over WiFi/Bluetooth, or via your own relay
  • 1-on-1 and group calls inside any pool
  • No phone number, no SIM, no contact-list upload

Connection Pool

One pool.Everything you do together.

Pools are the social layer of StealthOS · chat, voice, video, multiplayer games, and relay tunneling, all over a single end-to-end encrypted connection. Pools stay alive when the host goes offline, so friends keep talking and playing without waiting for you to come back.

  • End-to-end encrypted messaging in every pool
  • Pools stay alive while the host is offline · reconnect with the same key
  • Open-source StealthRelay support for self-hosted private relay
  • Local peer-to-peer or remote relay · same UI, same encryption

Relay Exit

Exit at your relay's IP,not your home network.

Route the app's browser and built-in network requests through your self-hosted StealthRelay. Destinations see the relay's IP, not yours · and the relay only sees ciphertext, because TLS to the destination stays end-to-end.

  • Browser & app traffic exits at your relay; TLS stays end-to-end
  • Affects only StealthOS app traffic · other apps are untouched
  • Per-pool host approval decides who else can use it as an exit
  • Off by default · automatic kill switch if the relay refuses traffic

System Snapshot

Take your whole systemwith you.

Save everything StealthOS holds · files, passwords, notes, browser history, settings · into one encrypted file, then restore it whenever you want. Even after a factory reset, or on a brand new install. It's encrypted with a passkey only you know, so nothing from the old device is needed to open it.

  • One file holds your vault, passwords, notes, browser data and settings
  • Encrypted with your passkey alone · AES-256-GCM, tamper-evident
  • Keep it in Files, iCloud Drive, or move it to a computer · we keep no copy
  • Restoring verifies the whole file before it replaces anything

There is no recovery without the passkey · not by you, not by us, not by anyone.

AI Safety

Threats caughtbefore you load them.

On-device AI flags phishing pages, scam patterns, and suspicious domains the moment a link is tapped · not after your credentials are gone. Domain intelligence, content blocking, and a duress password give you a stack of safety nets, all running locally.

  • AI phishing detection for fake login pages and scam sites
  • Domain intelligence for newly-registered, shared-IP, and impersonating domains
  • Content blocking for ads, trackers, and fingerprinting scripts
  • Duress password: emergency wipe with a single login

On-device AI

An assistant thatstays on your device.

Powered by Apple Intelligence on iOS 26+. Choose a profile · writing, coding, tutoring, planning, research, analysis · talk to it with voice mode, save answers to Notes, or export code blocks straight to a file. Nothing leaves your phone.

  • Profiles for writing, coding, tutoring, planning, research, and analysis
  • Voice mode with interruption support, plus web research and weather
  • Save answers to Notes or export code blocks as files

Notes · Voice · Reminders

  • Voice notes with multi-speaker transcription and summaries

  • Inline checklists for daily todos and meeting follow-ups
  • Everything stored inside the encrypted vault

Virtual Desktop

A workspacebehind one password.

A windowed, themable workspace with movable windows, folders, and a password lock · 15+ built-in apps for private productivity and communication, all inside the same encrypted shell.

  • Movable windows, folders, themes, and a master password lock
  • 15+ built-in apps for productivity and communication
  • Notes, Calculator, Files, Profiles, Help, AI, and more
  • Pool Chat, Voice/Video, Games · all over Connection Pool

Multiplayer Games

Play with friendsover your own pool.

Nine multiplayer titles · Chess, Ludo, Connect Four, Chain Reaction, Memory Rush, Word Guess and more · running over the same end-to-end encrypted Connection Pool. No matchmaker, no game server, no third-party seeing your moves.

  • Local peer-to-peer when nearby, or via your relay anywhere

Privacy · Free forever

Every privacy feature.Free, forever.

Tor, encryption, anti-fingerprinting, calling, and the AI assistant are free forever · no account required, zero analytics, zero tracking. Premium funds the project; it doesn't gate the privacy.
